design_detail: Progressive annual net wealth tax of 0.5% to 3% on net assets exceeding 500 million yen
quote_original: 富裕層の資産に対して、低率で毎年課税する新たな税として、「富裕税」を創設します。純資産が5億円を超える場合に、その超過部分に対して、0.5~3%程度の範囲で累進的な税率で課税します。
quote_en: We will create a new 'wealth tax' as an annual low-rate tax on the assets of the wealthy. If net assets exceed 500 million yen, the portion exceeding that threshold will be taxed at progressive rates between 0.5% and 3%.
source_title: 2024年総選挙各分野の政策 49、税制――消費税減税、大企業・富裕層への優遇をただす改革を
grading_note: Official party election manifesto proposal for an annual progressive net wealth tax with specific thresholds and rates.

design_detail: Progressive tax of 0.5% to 3% on net assets exceeding 500 million yen
quote_original: 我が党も、富裕層への資産課税として富裕税というのを提案しています。我が党の提案は、富裕層の純資産五億円を超える部分に〇・五から三％程度の累進課税をすると。
quote_en: Our party also proposes a wealth tax as asset taxation on the wealthy. Our proposal is to impose a progressive tax of about 0.5 to 3% on the portion of the wealthy's net assets exceeding 500 million yen.
source_title: 第217回国会 参議院 財政金融委員会 第2号
publisher: National Diet Library (国会会議録検索システム)

design_detail: Tax on portion of assets exceeding 500 million yen at 1% to 3% progressive rates
